answer: The summit schedule is applied in nebula and vine makes public each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1665 identities would post 3650 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
